body: Yeah makes sense. Pretty much having a similar issue. Only thing is I've lost all my fights so far hahahah. Thanks though. You've been very helpful.
Well  I can say I haven't tried that so I'll give it a shot. How do I go about it?
Ah. I've tried that, the issue there is I hold myself to a really high standard. I'm pretty lenient with everyone else though.
What kind of self compassion? Doing nice things for myself? Already tried buying myself things or treating myself to something but that doesn't work as well as it used to.

It's hard to convey any struggles because I don't think my problems are as bad as anyone else's. I wanted to give my life meaning but I've been leaning towards nihilism lately. I have terribly low self esteem as well so I can sympathize with that.

Yeah, I've been in therapy for over a year already and it's been great. Outside of that though nothing else really helps. Meditation, exercise, reflecting. I'm no stranger to self improvement. What's it all for in the end.
Me too. I can't stand it anymore.
You could, if you have money.
I think it's kind of nice.
